new_padding_audit.status: passes independent source-level algebra, exact-rational derandomization, and recursive resource audit of the final two-stage theorem
new_padding_audit.hypotheses: lambda>=4; D_arr=Q^2<=s<=2^lambda; M>=4 D_arr Delta lambda^4; maximum vertex degree<=Delta.
new_padding_audit.construction: Greedily label whole row vertices into Q groups, obtaining row-group load<=M/Q+Delta. Independently and uniformly label whole column vertices, then derandomize by exact rational conditional expectation.
new_padding_audit.potential: With mu=M/D_arr, z=1+1/(Delta lambda^2), and B=ceil((1+2/lambda)mu), use sum over cells z^(X_cell-B). The initial expectation is at most D_arr exp(-4lambda)<1.
new_padding_audit.derandomization: Conditioning on whole-column labels leaves a product over independent unassigned vertices. Its exact rational average over the Q choices equals the current potential, so a minimizing choice never increases it. Integer loads at the end satisfy X_cell<B.
new_padding_audit.exact_bound: H_pad<= (1+2/lambda) M/D_arr + L. With L D_arr/M<=1/lambda, total padded slots<=kappa M for kappa=1+3/lambda.
consequences: real ports per side and coordinate symbol<=kappa M/r
new_padding_audit.uniformity: The final integer capacity cap makes all packing gates valid at every actual non-fallback active call. The number of active depths is O(log lambda), so kappa^d=1+o(1) uniformly.
new_padding_audit.integrality: H_pad is rounded to a multiple of L. The original orientation-class packet construction and exact padded symbol marginals are unchanged; parallel edges remain distinct ports.
new_padding_audit.prior_report_overlap: No two-stage whole-vertex conditional-expectation construction or leading-one padded-slot bound found in the seven reports. Their contraction analyses retain3M/L,6M/D,6M/r.

new_guard_audit.status: independently derived and agrees with the final additive guard and adaptive-cap construction
new_guard_audit.schedule: g=ceil(8 log2(lambda+1)); d_max=ceil(log2 lambda); G=(d_max+1)g; r=54; A=max{A>=0 integer:4 r^(2A) Delta lambda^6<=s}; K=A-G; u_d=floor(8K/9^(d+1)); a_d=sum_{j<=d}u_j+(d+1)g.
new_guard_audit.finite_size_guards: Use direct contraction if the cap set is empty, lambda<4, K<=0, or an actual active call has u_d=0. No positivity requirement is imposed at the artificial depth d_max.
new_guard_audit.reason: Inherited precision is at most O(s lambda^2 2^(a_(d-1))), while MD/u>=s 2^(a_(d-1)+g)/lambda^2 at active nodes. The ratio is O(lambda^4/2^g)=o(1), uniformly.
new_guard_audit.capacity: The geometric taper sum is at most K, so a_d<=A at every relevant depth. The cap gives 4 D_arr Delta lambda^4<=s/lambda^2<M, and also gives the degree and packet-rounding gates.
new_guard_audit.uniformity: K=lambda/(20 log2 54)-O((log lambda)^2). Every actual active depth is less than log_26(lambda) for sufficiently large lambda, so the least active taper is bounded below by a positive power of lambda. Floor and guard losses are uniform relative o(1).
new_guard_audit.packet_budget: The guard reserve G=O((log lambda)^2)=o(lambda) is paid explicitly by the cap. This replaces the prior factor-two cumulative taper without leaving fixed asymptotic slack.
new_guard_audit.prior_report_overlap: The seven reports retain a_d=2 sum u_j in their global constructions; the final additive-guard and adaptive-cap construction is new relative to those reports.

final_comparison_addendum.note: Prior optimized-family boundary is an approachable limiting certificate. All comparable members of that prior family have larger coefficients; this is not an actual-runtime lower bound.
